Great success was anticipated for the URA 
Finals. However, a major accident occurred 
right at this moment.

Due to days of stormy weather, the turf 
being grown for racing had been utterly 
devastated.

Amidst fears that the event might be 
cancelled, Chairwoman Akikawa took off on 
her own to resolve the issue.

I dearly wanted to help Chairwoman 
Akikawa. Yet, unsure of how to break 
through the situation— Tazuna and I racked 
our brains together.
